decisions.reason: Two-component resin injection builds directly on the firm's plural-component dosing and pumping know-how, so it can keep refining the unit in-house, although the missing website evidence for 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.
It draws on the same core plural-component knowledge as Product A, but the overlap between the two units and the lack of recent visibility raise the risk that the range is consolidated.
Automatic airless guns sit at the centre of the firm's spray application expertise and manufacturing, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from results and improve the product.

The multi-model air-assisted airless line extends established spray technology for industrial coating customers, though the earlier withdrawal of the manual gun shows the firm does prune its gun portfolio.

The data logger relies on digital and electronic knowledge further from the firm's mechanical core, which makes it harder to assimilate, but it supports service and the trend towards monitoring coating quality, so the firm keeps it while it builds that knowledge.
